env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

logos build -o $WORK/sum-native$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/sum-native$GOEXE
stdout '^0$'
stdout '^4341c37937e08000$'
stdout '^4b189680$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt

env GOARCH=arm64
logos build -o $WORK/sum-arm64$GOEXE .
env GOARCH=

[!exec:qemu-aarch64] skip 'qemu-aarch64 is required for the arm64 leg'
exec qemu-aarch64 $WORK/sum-arm64$GOEXE
cp stdout $WORK/arm64.txt

cmp $WORK/native.txt $WORK/arm64.txt

-- go.mod --
module example.com/sumcross

go 1.27

-- main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"math"
)
func f64v(i int) float64 {
	switch i % 5 {
	case 0:
		return 1e16
	case 1:
		return -1e16
	case 2:
		return 1.0
	case 3:
		return 0.1
	}
	return -0.5
}

func f32v(i int) float32 {
	switch i % 5 {
	case 0:
		return 1e7
	case 1:
		return -1e7
	case 2:
		return 1.0
	case 3:
		return 0.1
	}
	return -0.5
}

func main() {
	ns := []int{0, 1, 2, 3, 7, 8, 9, 1000, 1023, 1024, 1025}
	for _, n := range ns {
		xs := make([]float64, n)
		for i := range xs {
			xs[i] = f64v(i)
		}
		fmt.Printf("%x\n", math.Float64bits(xs.sum()))
	}
	for _, n := range ns {
		xs := make([]float32, n)
		for i := range xs {
			xs[i] = f32v(i)
		}
		fmt.Printf("%x\n", math.Float32bits(xs.sum()))
	}
	k64 := 0.1
	for _, n := range ns {
		xs := make([]float64, n)
		for i := range xs {
			xs[i] = f64v(i)
		}
		fmt.Printf("%x\n", math.Float64bits(xs.map(x => k64*x).sum()))
	}
	k32 := float32(0.1)
	for _, n := range ns {
		xs := make([]float32, n)
		for i := range xs {
			xs[i] = f32v(i)
		}
		fmt.Printf("%x\n", math.Float32bits(xs.map(x => k32*x).sum()))
	}
}
